# Function to calculate P95 thresholds for a filtered metric DataFrame
def calculate_p95_thresholds(df):
    # Group by component and KPI name, calculate 95th percentile of 'value'
    p95_df = df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'name'])['value'].quantile(0.95).reset_index()
    p95_df.rename(columns={'value': 'p95_threshold'}, inplace=True)
    return p95_df

# Calculate P95 thresholds for node metrics

# Calculate P95 thresholds for container metrics

# Calculate P95 thresholds for service metrics
service_p95_thresholds = calculate_p95_thresholds(service_metrics)

# Combine all thresholds into one DataFrame for convenience
global_p95_thresholds = pd.concat([node_p95_thresholds, container_p95_thresholds, service_p95_thresholds], ignore_index=True)
